data_description.outdoor_humidity_sensor: Combined with the outdoor temperature sensor, this enables sensors comparing indoor and outdoor air. A weather entity can also be used.
data_description.wind_speed_sensor: Wind speed measured at the location of the temperature and humidity sensors (outdoors), used to calculate wind chill and apparent temperature. Only configure this for outdoor setups or weather entities, not for indoor rooms.
